pixelPolicy: 原始PNG按字节复制；未裁切、重绘、去底、缩放或修改原像素。alpha分析仅在内存读取。
globalReviewNotes: 已用view_image完整检查两张输出。各关两个平台的材料/构造有清楚差异。
全部为低厚度平台；无旧稿长冰锥、下垂根须或高柱。局部短碎边、叶片与装饰仍在主体附近。
图像RGB通道保留了渐变底色，但背景对应alpha为0；应按RGBA正常绘制，不能丢弃alpha后把RGB视作背景。
实际平台比目标约650px略宽；实际站立线较提示词目标y84偏低，应使用逐格显式裁切和建议锚点，不盲信等分cell中的同一归一化锚点。
画面风格和手感仍待主Agent接入检查及用户主观验收。
实际alpha>=16主体宽693～705px、高96～120px；比约650px目标稍宽，整体仍为浅厚度。站立线在各原始cell中约84～124px，未逐行严格命中84px目标；显式crop后的建议站立线位于crop上方12～34px。
alpha>=16语义主体未跨格；中心56px隔离带alpha最大1/2，横向20px行缝alpha最大1，存在肉眼不可见的极低alpha残边，未通过脚本清理。正常drawImage可按建议crop限定原图。

files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite atlas of eight isolated walkable platforms for a dark-fantasy side-scrolling action game.
Primary request: Generate ONE 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG with a REAL transparent alpha background. Exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows, exactly 8 separate platform sprites, one sprite in each invisible 768 x 256 cell. No visible grid. Every row contains two genuinely different platform designs for the same stage theme; they must differ in silhouette, construction and material, not be mirrored duplicates.

Exact layout: left column assets centered at x384, right at x1152. Four row centers y128,384,640,896. In each cell the complete platform is approximately 650 pixels wide and only 110 to 135 pixels high overall, with an elongated 5:1 to 6:1 width-to-height silhouette. Each platform has a long horizontal FLAT walkable top, whose front standing lip is near y84 relative to its row cell (global y84,340,596,852). A very narrow visible upper surface gives slight downward viewing perspective; front face remains nearly side-on. Keep the top unobstructed. Use the same scale and viewing angle throughout. Keep all pixels inside their cell, at least 45 transparent pixels left/right and at least 45 transparent pixels above/below. Large completely transparent gutters separate all 8 sprites.

Style/medium: refined detailed hand-painted 2D game asset, dark Gothic fantasy, tactile painted stone/ice/wood/chitin, believable compact construction, crisp readable silhouette, restrained highlights, richer detail on front face. Side view with only modest top visibility, not an isometric floating island. Subtle ambient occlusion inside the object only. No ambient backdrop, no cast shadow on an imaginary ground.

ROW 1, snow mountain theme:
LEFT: broad thin slab of dark glacial rock capped by a smooth level layer of white snow and pale blue compact ice, a softly fractured natural-rock outline, only a few very short ice teeth at the underside, compact nearly horizontal bottom.
RIGHT: weathered ice-sealed masonry cornice made from fitted blue-gray stone blocks and carved horizontal ledges, clean flat snowy tread, shallow stepped rectangular profile, a few short tiny ice fringes. Make its man-built layered silhouette visibly different from the natural slab at left.
ROW 2, volcanic furnace theme:
LEFT: low wide dark red-black basalt slab with small dim ember-red fissures, irregular broken rock edges, level dark solid tread, shallow compact base.
RIGHT: shallow riveted dark iron furnace cornice over blocky scorched stone, horizontal metal band and small rivets, level worn iron tread, squared engineered outline; a tiny internal orange glow, no flames.
ROW 3, poisonous swamp theme:
LEFT: shallow fragmented gray green stone slab covered in compact poisonous moss and a few tiny olive plants at ends, clean flat central tread, short jagged rocky underside, dim toxic accents only.
RIGHT: a shallow horizontal wooden platform woven from thick old roots and weathered timber, compact interlaced woody front face, only a few small leaves at ends, roots contained within a low horizontal band, flat walkable plank/root top. A clearly woody rectangular construction unlike left stone.
ROW 4, dream spider nest theme:
LEFT: low old cracked gray stone cornice with a few sparse fine pale cobweb strands hugging the front and edges, top remains clear, compact stepped stone bottom, no hanging web curtains.
RIGHT: shallow dark purple chitin shell platform composed of broad overlapping plated shell segments, flat tread with tiny beveled ridges, low curved armored front profile, short shell edge details only. It must read as chitin rather than wrapped stone.

CRITICAL THINNESS RULE: these are shallow ledges, not large floating islands. Each sprite's entire depth below the standing lip is only about 90 to 110 pixels. The bottom must be shallow and compact, mostly horizontal. No long icicles, no long spikes, no pointed inverted triangle shape, no taper to a deep center, no hanging roots, no dangling vines, no pillars, no vertical support columns, no long stalactites. Short underside details at most 15 pixels. Do not let any decoration cross a cell boundary.
No text, no numbers, no labels, no frames, no borders, no scenery, no characters, no ground, no tall vegetation, no fog, no backdrop gradient, no glow that could cover a character, no checkerboard pattern. Background must be genuinely transparent.
